blocks.text: Dionela, IV of Spades, and SB19 emerged as the top honorees at the 39th Awit Awards held on Tuesday, Sept. 15, in Pasay City. Dionela led this year’s winners with four recognition—Best Vocal Arrangement, Best Collaboration, Best Rap/HipHop Recording, and Best R&B Recording for his single “Ikigai” which featured rapper Loonie.
